vb16:199.2: gamaṇaṃ vā ṭhānaṃ vā nisajjaṃ vā seyyaṃ vā.

vb16:201.1: Pañcahi viññāṇehi ne kāyakammaṃ na vacīkammaṃ paṭṭhapetīti: pañcahi viññāṇehi na kāyakamaṃ na vacīkammaṃ paṭṭhapeti.
vb16:202.1: Pañcannaṃ viññāṇānaṃ samanantarā pi na kāyakammaṃ na vacīkammaṃ paṭṭhapetīti: pañcannaṃ viññāṇānaṃ samanantarā manodhātuyā pi na kāyakammaṃ na vacīkammaṃ paṭṭhapeti.
vb16:203.1: Pañcahi viññāṇehi na kusalākusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādiyatīti: pañcāhi viññāṇehi na kusalākusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādiyati.
vb16:204.1: Pañcannaṃ viññāṇānaṃ samanantarā pi na kusalākusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādiyatīti: pañcannaṃ viññāṇānaṃ samanantarā manodhātuyā pi na kusalākusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādiyāti.
vb16:205.1: Pañcahi viññāṇehi na samāpajjati na vuṭṭhātīti: pañcahi viññāṇehi na samāpajjati na vuṭṭhāti.
vb16:206.1: Pañcannaṃ viññāṇānaṃ samanantarā pi na samāpajjati na vuṭṭhātīti: pañcannaṃ viññāñāṇaṃ samanantarā manodhātuyā pi na samāpajjati na vuṭṭhāti.
vb16:207.1: Pañcahi viññāṇehi na cavati na upajjatīti: pañcahi viññāṇehi na cavati na uppajjati.

vb16:209.1: Pañcahi viññāṇehi na supati na paṭibujjhati na supinaṃ passatīti: pañcahi viññāṇehi na supati na paṭibujjhati na supinaṃ passati.

vb16:220.1: Tīsu bhūmīsu kusalāvyākate paññā ganthavippayuttaganthaniyā paññā; catūsu maggesu catūsu phalesu paññā ganthavippayutta-aganthaniyā paññā.

vb16:291.2: Atīte dhamme ārabbha yā uppajjati paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:

vb16:296.2: Bahiddhā dhamme ārabha yā uppajjati paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammāditthi:
vb16:297.2: Ajjhattabahiddhā dhamme ārabbha yā uppajjati paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:

vb16:299.5: Ṭhapetvā saccānulomikaṃ ñāṇaṃ sabbā pi sāsavā kusalā paññā kammassakataṃ ñāṇaṃ.

vb16:303.1: Maggasamaṅgissa ñāṇaṃ dukkhe p' etaṃ ñāṇaṃ dukkhasamudaye p' etaṃ ñāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhe p' etaṃ ñāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya p' etaṃ ñāṇaṃ.

vb16:305.3: dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ arabbha yā uppajjati paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb16:306.1: Kāmāvacarakusalāvyākate paññā kāmāvacarā paññā. Rūpāvacarakusalāvyākate paññā rūpāvacarā paññā. Arūpāvacarakusalāvyākate paññā arūpāvacarā paññā. Catūsu maggesu catūsu phalesu paññā apariyāpannā paññā.
vb16:307.2: Catūsu maggesu catūsu phalesu paññā dhamme ñāṇaṃ.
vb16:308.1: So iminā dhammena ñātena diṭṭhena pattena viditena pariyogāḷhena atītānāgate nayaṃ neti.
vb16:308.2: Ye hi keci atītam addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā dukkhaṃ abbhaññiṃsu dukkhasamudayaṃ abbhaññiṃsu dukkhanirodhaṃ abbhañ ñiṃsu dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abbhaññiṃsu, imaṃ yeva te dukkhaṃ abbhaññiṃsu, imaṃ yeva te dukkhasamudayaṃ abbhaññiṃsu, imaṃ yeva te dukkhanirodhaṃ abbhaññiṃsu, imaṃ yeva te dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abbhaññiṃsu.
vb16:308.3: Ye hi pi keci anāgatam addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā dukkhaṃ abhijānissanti dukkhasamudayaṃ abhijānissanti dukkhanirodhaṃ abhijānissanti dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhijānissanti, imaṃ yeva te dukkhaṃ abhijānissanti, imaṃ yeva te dukkhasamudayaṃ abhijānissanti, imaṃ yeva te dukkhanirodhaṃ abhijānissanti, imaṃ yeva te dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhijānissantīti:
vb16:308.4: yā tattha paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb16:309.2: Idha bhikkhu parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti:

vb16:309.4: yā tattha paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb16:310.1: Ṭhapetvā dhamme ñāṇaṃ, anvaye ñāṇaṃ, paricce ñāṇaṃ, avasesā paññā sammatiñāṇaṃ.
vb16:311.1: Tattha katamā paññā ācayāya no apacayāya?
vb16:312.1: Catūsu maggesu paññā apacayāya no ācayāya.
vb16:313.1: Rūpāvacara-arūpāvacarakusale paññā ācayāya ceva apacayāya ca.
vb16:314.1: Avasesā paññā neva ācayāya no apacayāya.
vb16:315.1: Tattha katamā paññā nibbidāya no paṭivedhāya?
vb16:315.2: Yāya paññāya kāmesu vītarāgo hoti, na ca abhiññāyo paṭivijjhati na ca saccāni:
vb16:315.3: ayaṃ vuccati paññā nibbidāya no paṭivedhāya.
vb16:316.1: Sveva paññāya kāmesu vītarāgo samāno abhiññāyo paṭivijjhati, na ca saccāni:
vb16:316.2: ayaṃ vuccati paññā paṭivedhāya no nibbidāya.
vb16:317.1: Catūsu maggesu paññā nibbidāya ceva paṭivedhāya ca.
vb16:318.1: Avasesā paññā neva nibbidāya no paṭivedhāya.
vb16:319.2: Paṭhamassa jhānassa lābhiṃ kāmasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti hānabhāginī paññā.

vb16:322.21: Nibbidāsahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti virāgūpasaṃhitā nibedhabhāginī paññā.
vb16:322.22: Ākiñcaññāyatanassa lābhiṃ viññāṇañcāyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti hānabhāginī paññā.
vb16:322.25: Nibbidāsahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti virāgūpasaṃhitā nibbedhabhāginī paññā.
vb16:323.3: Atthe ñāṇaṃ atthapaṭisambhidā. Dhamme ñāṇaṃ dhammapaṭisambhidā. Tatra dhammaniruttābhilāpe ñāṇaṃ niruttipaṭisambhidā. Ñāṇesu ñāṇaṃ paṭibhāṇapaṭisambhidā.
vb16:324.2: Dukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā paññā, dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā paññā, sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā paññā, sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā paññā.

vb16:327.1: Tattha katamā sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā paññā?
vb16:327.2: Akicchena akasirena samādhiṃ uppādentassa dandhaṃ taṇṭhānaṃ abhijānantassa yā uppajjati paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb16:327.3: ayaṃ vuccati sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā paññā.
vb16:328.1: Tattha katamā sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā paññā?
vb16:328.2: Akicchena akasirena samādhiṃ uppādentassa khippaṃ taṇṭhānaṃ abhijānantassa yā uppajjati paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb16:328.3: ayaṃ vuccati sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā paññā.
vb16:329.2: Parittā parittārammaṇā paññā, parittā appamāṇārammaṇā paññā, appamāṇā parittārammaṇā paññā, appamāṇā appamāṇārammaṇā paññā.
vb16:330.2: Samādhissa na nikāmalābhissa ārammaṇaṃ thokaṃ pharantassa yā uppajjati paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:

vb16:332.2: Samādhissa nikāmalābhissa ārammaṇaṃ thokaṃ pharantassa yā uppajjati paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb16:333.2: Samādhissa nikāmalābhissa ārammaṇaṃ vipulaṃ pharantassa yā uppajjati paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb16:334.1: Maggasamaṅgissa ñāṇaṃ jarāmaraṇe p' etaṃ ñāṇaṃ jarāmaraṇasamudaye p' etaṃ ñāṇaṃ jarāmaraṇanirodhe p' etaṃ ñāṇaṃ jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya p' etaṃ ñāṇaṃ.
vb16:335.2: Jarāmaraṇaṃ ārabbha yā uppajjati paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb16:336.3: jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ ārabbha yā uppajjati paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb16:337.1: Maggasamaṅgissa ñāṇaṃ jātiyā p' etaṃ ñāṇaṃ . . . pe . . .
vb16:337.10: Saṅkhāre p' etaṃ ñāṇaṃ, saṅkhārasamudaye p' etaṃ ñāṇaṃ, saṅkhāranirodhe p' etaṃ ñāṇaṃ, saṅkhāranirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya p' etaṃ ñāṇaṃ.
vb16:338.2: Saṅkhāre ārabbha yā uppajjati paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb16:339.3: saṅkhāranirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ ārabbha yā uppajjati paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb16:342.7: Tamhā tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhitassa paccavekkhaṇāñāṇaṃ paccavekkhaṇānimittaṃ.
vb16:343.2: Ayaṃ samādhi paccuppannasukho ceva āyatiñ ca sukhavipāko ti: paccattaṃ yeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati.
vb16:343.3: Ayaṃ samādhi ariyo nirāmiso ti: paccattaṃ yeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati.
vb16:343.4: Ayaṃ samādhi akāpurisasevito ti: paccattaṃ yeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati.
vb16:343.5: Ayaṃ samādhi santo paṇīto paṭippassaddhiladdho ekodibhāvādhigato na ca sasaṅkhāraniggayhavāritavato ti: paccattaṃ yeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati.
vb16:343.6: So kho panāhaṃ imaṃ samādhiṃ sato 'va samāpajjāmi sato 'va vuṭṭhahāmīti: paccattaṃ yeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjat.
vb16:345.2: Iddhividhe ñāṇaṃ, sotadhātuvisuddhiyā ñāṇaṃ, paracitte ñāṇaṃ, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ, sattānaṃ cutūpapāte ñāṇaṃ, āsavānaṃ khaye ñāṇaṃ.
vb16:347.2: Jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇan ti ñāṇaṃ, asati jātiyā natthi jarāmaraṇan ti ñāṇaṃ, atītam pi addhānaṃ jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇan ti ñāṇaṃ, asati jātiyā natthi jarāmaraṇan ti ñāṇaṃ, anāgatam pi addhānaṃ jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇan ti ñāṇaṃ, asati jātiyā natthi jarāmaraṇan ti ñāṇaṃ,

vb16:347.13: Avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā ti ñāṇaṃ, asati avijjāya natthi saṅkhārā ti ñāṇaṃ, atītam pi addhānaṃ avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā ti ñāṇaṃ, asati avijjāya natthi saṅkhārā ti ñāṇaṃ, anāgatam pi addhānaṃ avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā ti ñāṇaṃ, asati avijjāya natthi saṅkhārā ti ñāṇaṃ,
vb16:347.14: yam p' issa taṃ dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇaṃ tam pi khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhamman ti ñāṇaṃ.
vb16:349.1: Tattha katamā catūsu maggesu catūsu phalesu paññā?
vb16:349.2: Sotāpattimagge paññā sotāpattiphale paññā; sakadāgāmimagge paññā, sakadāgāmiphale paññā; anāgāmimagge paññā, anāgāmiphale paññā; arahattamage paññā, arahattaphale paññā;
vb16:349.3: imā catūsu maggesu catūsu phalesu paññā.
vb16:351.2: Paṭhamajjhānasamāpattiyā paññā, dutiyajjhānasamāpattiyā paññā, tatiyajjhānasamāpattiyā paññā, catutthajjhānasamāpattiyā paññā; ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā paññā, viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā paññā, ākiñcaññāyatana-samāpattiyā paññā, neva-saññā-nāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā paññā; saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhitassa paccavekkhaṇāñāṇaṃ.
vb16:353.1: Tattha katamaṃ tathāgatassa ṭhānañ ca ṭhānato aṭṭhānañ ca aṭṭhānato yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ?
vb16:353.2: Idha tathāgato: aṭṭhānam etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo kañci saṅkhāraṃ niccato upagaccheyya, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:353.3: ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ puthujjano kañci saṅkhāraṃ niccato upagaccheyya, ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:353.4: aṭṭhānam etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo kañci saṅkhāraṃ sukhato upagaccheyya, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti pajānati;
vb16:353.5: ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ puthujjano kañci saṅkhāraṃ sukhato upagaccheyya, ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:353.6: aṭṭhānam etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo kañci dhammaṃ attato upagaccheyya, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:353.7: ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ puthujjano kañci dhammaṃ attato upagaccheyya, ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:353.8: aṭṭhānam etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo mātaraṃ jīvitā voropeyya, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:353.9: ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ puthujjano mātaraṃ jīvitā voropeyya, ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:354.1: aṭṭhānam etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo pitaraṃ jīvitā voropeyya . . . pe . . .
vb16:354.6: aṭṭhamaṃ bhavaṃ nibbatteyya, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:354.7: ṭhanañ kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ puthujjano aṭṭhamaṃ bhavaṃ nibbatteyya, ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:355.1: aṭṭhānam etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ ekissā lokadhātuyā dve arahanto sammāsambuddhā apubbaṃ acarimaṃ uppajjeyyuṃ, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:355.2: ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ ekissā lokadhātuyā eko arahaṃ sammāsambuddho uppajjeyya, ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:355.3: aṭṭhānam etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ ekissā lokadhātuyā dve rājāno cakkavattino apubbaṃ acarimaṃ uppajjeyyuṃ, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:355.4: ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ ekissā lokadhātuyā eko rājā cakkavatti uppajjeyya, ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:356.1: aṭṭhānam etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ itthi arahaṃ assa sammāsambuddho, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:356.2: ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ puriso arahaṃ assa sammāsambuddho, ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:356.3: aṭṭhānam etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ itthi rājā assa cakkavatti, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:356.4: ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ puriso rājā assa cakkavatti, ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:356.5: aṭṭhānam etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ itthi Sakkattaṃ kāreyya, Mārattaṃ kāreyya, Brahmattaṃ kāreyya, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:356.6: ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ puriso Brahmattaṃ kāreyya, ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:357.1: aṭṭhānam etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ kāyaduccaritassa iṭṭho kanto manāpo vipāko nibbatteyya, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:357.2: ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ kāyaduccaritassa aniṭṭho akanto amanāpo vipāko nibbatteyya, ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:357.4: yaṃ manoduccaritassa iṭṭho kanto manāpo vipāko nibbatteyya, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:357.6: yaṃ manoduccaritassa aniṭṭho akanto amanāpo vipāko nibbatteyya, ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:358.1: aṭṭhānam etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ kāyasucaritassa aniṭṭho akanto amanāpo vipāko nibbatteyya, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:358.2: ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ kāyasucaritassa iṭṭho kanto manāpo vipāko nibbatteyya, ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:358.4: yaṃ mano-sucaritassa aniṭṭho akanto amanāpo vipāko nibbatteyya, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;
vb16:358.6: yaṃ manosucaritassa iṭṭho kanto manāpo vipāko nibbatteyya, ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;

vb16:359.4: yaṃ manoduccaritasamaṅgī taṃ-nidānā tappaccayā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjeyya, n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti pajānāti;

vb16:360.7: Ye ye dhammā yesaṃ yesaṃ dhammānaṃ hetū paccayā uppādāya, taṃ taṃ ṭhānaṃ; ye ye dhammā yesaṃ yesaṃ dhammānaṃ na hetū na paccayā uppādāya, taṃ taṃ aṭṭhānan ti:

vb16:365.1: Tattha katamaṃ tathāgatassa sabbatthagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ?
vb16:365.2: Idha tathāgato: ayaṃ maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā nirayagāminī ti pajānāti, ayaṃ maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā tiracchānagāminī ti pajānāti, ayaṃ maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā pittivisayagāminī ti pajānāti, ayaṃ maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā manussalokagāminī ti pajānāti, ayaṃ maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā devalokagāminī ti pajānāti, ayaṃ maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā nibbānagāminī ti pajānāti . . .
vb16:365.3: yā tattha paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:

vb16:366.1: Tattha katamaṃ tathāgatassa anekadhātuṃ nānādhātuṃ lokaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ?
vb16:366.2: Idha tathāgatho khandhanānattaṃ pajānāti, dhātunānattaṃ pajānāti, āyatananānattaṃ pajānāti, anekadhātuṃ nānādhātuṃ lokanānattaṃ pajānāti:
vb16:366.3: yā tattha paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:

vb16:367.1: Tattha katamaṃ tathāgatassa sattānaṃ nānādhimuttikataṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ?
vb16:367.3: santi sattā hīnādhimuttikā, santi sattā paṇītādhimuttikā;
vb16:367.4: hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttike satte sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti,
vb16:367.5: paṇītādhimuttikā sattā paṇītādhimuttike satte sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti;
vb16:368.1: atītam pi addhānaṃ hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttike satte seviṃsu bhajiṃsu payirupāsiṃsu, paṇītādhimuttikā sattā paṇitādhimuttike satte seviṃsu bhajiṃsu payirupāsiṃsu;
vb16:369.1: anāgatam pi addhānaṃ hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttike satte sevissanti bhajissanti payirupāsissanti, paṇītādhimuttikā sattā panītādhimuttike satte sevissanti bhajissanti payirupāsissantīti:
vb16:369.2: yā tattha paññā pajānānā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb16:369.3: idaṃ tathāgatassa sattānaṃ nānādhimuttikataṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ.
vb16:370.1: Tattha katamaṃ tathāgatassa parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ indriyaparopariyattaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ?
vb16:370.2: Idha tathāgato sattānaṃ āsayaṃ pajānāti, anusayaṃ pajānāti, caritaṃ pajānāti, adhimuttiṃ pajānāti, apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye bhabbābhabbe satte pajānāti.
vb16:371.2: Sassato loko ti vā asassato loko ti vā antavā loko ti vā anantavā loko ti vā taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran ti vā aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran ti vā hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā: iti bhavadiṭṭhisannissitā vā sattā honti vibhavadiṭṭhisannissitā vā,
vb16:371.3: ete vā pana ubho anto anupagamma idappaccayatā-paṭiccasamuppannesu dhammesu anulomikā khanti paṭiladdhā hoti, yathābhūtaṃ vā ñāṇaṃ:
vb16:372.3: kāmarāgānusayo patighānusayo mānānusayo diṭṭhānusayo vicikicchānusayo bhavarāgānusayo avijjānusayo.
vb16:372.4: Yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ ettha sattānaṃ rāgānusayo anuseti;
vb16:372.5: yaṃ loke appiyarūpaṃ asātarūpaṃ ettha sattānaṃ paṭighānusayo anuseti:
vb16:372.6: iti imesu dvīsu dhammesu avijjā anupatitā,
vb16:372.7: tadekaṭṭho māno ca diṭṭhi ca vicikicchā ca daṭṭhabbā:
vb16:373.2: Puññābhisaṅkhāro apuññābhisaṅkhāro āneñjābhisaṅkhāro parittabhūmako vā mahābhūmako vā:
vb16:374.2: Santi sattā hīnādhimuttikā, santi sattā paṇītādhimuttikā;
vb16:374.3: hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttike satte sevanti bhajanti payirupā santi,
vb16:374.4: paṇītādhimuttikatā sattā paṇītādhimuttike satte sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti;
vb16:375.1: atītam pi addhānaṃ hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttike satte seviṃsu bhajiṃsu payirupāsiṃsu,
vb16:375.2: paṇītādhimuttikā sattā paṇītādhimuttike satte seviṃsu bhajiṃsu payirupāsiṃsu;
vb16:376.1: anāgatam pi addhānaṃ hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttike satte sevissanti bhajissanti payiru pāsissanti,
vb16:376.2: paṇītādhimuttikā sattā panītādhimuttike satte sevissanti bhajissanti payirupāsissanti:
vb16:377.3: lobho doso moho māno diṭṭhi vicikicchā thīnaṃ uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ.
vb16:377.4: Yesaṃ sattānaṃ imāni dasa kilesavatthūni āsevitāni bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni ussadagatāni: ime te sattā mahārajakkhā.
vb16:378.2: Yesaṃ sattānaṃ imāni dasa kilesavatthūni anāsevitāni abhāvitāni abahulīkatāni anussadagatāni: ime te sattā apparajakkhā.
vb16:379.4: Yesaṃ sattānaṃ imāni pañcindriyāni anāsevitāni abhāvitāni abahulīkatāni anussadagatāni: ime te sattā mudindriyā.
vb16:380.2: Yesaṃ sattānaṃ imāni pañcindriyāni āsevitāni bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni ussadagatāni: ime te sattā tikkhindriyā.
vb16:381.2: Ye te sattā pāpāsayā pāpānusayā pāpacaritā pāpādhimuttikā mahārajakkhā mudindriyā: ime te sattā dvākārā.
vb16:382.2: Ye te sattā kalyāṇāsayā kalyāṇacaritā kalyāṇādhimuttikā apparajakkhā tikkhindriyā: ime te sattā svākārā.
vb16:383.2: Ye va te sattā dvākārā te va te sattā duviññāpayā.
vb16:383.3: Yeva te sattā svākārā te va te sattā suviññāpayā.
vb16:384.2: Ye te sattā kammāvaraṇena samannāgatā kilesāvaraṇena samannāgatā vipākāvaraṇena samannāgatā assaddhā acchandikā duppaññā abhabbā niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ: ime te sattā abhabbā.
vb16:385.2: Ye te sattā na kammāvaraṇena samannāgatā na kilesāvaraṇena samannāgatā na vipākāvaraṇena samannāgatā saddhā chandikā paññavanto bhabbā niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ: ime te sattā bhabbā ti:
vb16:385.3: yā tattha paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb16:385.4: idaṃ tathāgatassa parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ indriyaparopariyattaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ.
vb16:386.1: Tattha katamaṃ tathāgatassa jhānavimokhasamādhisamāpattīnaṃ saṅkilesaṃ vodānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ?
vb16:386.3: atth' ekacco jhāyī sampattiṃ yeva samānaṃ vipattīti paccati , atth' ekacco jhāyī vipattiṃ yeva samānaṃ sampattīti pacceti, atth' ekacco jhāyī sampattiṃ yeva samānaṃ sampattīti pacceti, atth' ekacco jhāyī vipattiṃ yeva samānaṃ vipattīti pacceti.

vb16:388.3: atth' ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo;
vb16:388.4: atth' ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca;
vb16:388.5: atth' ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo.

vb16:393.1: Sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā: ananto ākāso ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati:
vb16:394.1: Sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma: anantaṃ viññāṇan ti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati:
vb16:395.1: Sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma: natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati:
vb16:396.1: Sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma neva-saññā-nāsaññāyatanaṃ upasamapajja viharati:
vb16:397.1: Sabbaso neva-saññā-nāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati:
vb16:398.3: savitakka-savicāro samādhi, avitakka-vicāramatto samādhi, avitakka-avicāro samādhi.
vb16:399.3: paṭhamajjhānasamāpatti dutiyajjhānasamāpatti tatiyajjhānasamāpatti catutthajjhānasamāpatti ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpatti viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpatti ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpatti neva-saññā-nāsaññāyatanasamāpatti saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpatti.
vb16:400.4: vodānam pi vuṭṭhānaṃ. Tamhā tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhānam pi vuṭṭhānan ti
vb16:400.5: yā tattha paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb16:400.6: idaṃ tathāgatassa jhānavimokhasamādhisamāpattīnaṃ saṅkilesaṃ vodānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ.
vb16:401.1: Tattha katamaṃ tathāgatassa pubbe nivāsānussatiṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ?
vb16:401.2: Idha tathāgato anekavihitaṃ pubbe nivāsaṃ anussarati, seyyathīdaṃ:
vb16:401.3: Ekam pi jātiṃ dve pi jātiyo tisso pi jātiyo catasso pi jātiyo pañca pi jātiyo, dasam pi jātiyo, vīsam pi jātiyo tiṃsam pi jātiyo cattāḷīsam pi jātiyo paññāsam pi jātiyo, jātisatam pi jātisahassam pi jātisatasahassam pi, aneke pi saṃvaṭṭakappe aneke pi vivaṭṭakappe aneke pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe: Amutr' āsiṃ evaṃ nāmo evaṃ gotto evaṃ vaṇṇo evam āhāro evaṃ sukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evam āyupariyanto, so tayo cuto amutra udapādiṃ,
vb16:401.4: tatrapāsiṃ evaṃ nāmo evaṃ gotto evaṃ vaṇṇo evam āhāro evaṃ sukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evam āyupariyanto, so tato cuto idhūpapanno ti:
vb16:401.5: iti sākāraṃ sa-uddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati:
vb16:401.6: yā tattha paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb16:402.1: Tattha katamaṃ tathāgatassa sattānaṃ cutūpapātaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ?
vb16:402.2: Idha tathāgato dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne uppajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammupage satte pajānāti:
vb16:402.3: ime vata bhonto sattā bhāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā,
vb16:402.4: te kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppannā.
vb16:402.5: Ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā,
vb16:402.6: te kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppannā ti;
vb16:402.7: iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne uppajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammupage satte pajānāti:
vb16:402.8: yā tattha paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb16:402.9: idaṃ tathāgatassa sattānaṃ cutūpapātaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ.
vb16:403.1: Tattha katamaṃ tathāgatassa āsavānaṃ khaye yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ?
vb16:403.2: Idha tathāgato āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiñā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati:
vb16:403.3: yā tattha paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb16:403.4: idaṃ tathāgatassa āsavānaṃ khaye yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇan ti. Imāni dasa tathāgatassa tathāgatabalāni,
vb16:404.1: yehi balehi samannāgato tathāgato āsabhaṭṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti. Evaṃ dasavidhena ñāṇavatthu. (Mātikā.)
